WHY A RING?

A quieter way
to wear your data.

A screenless ring keeps notifications off your finger. Your insights live in the Oura App, ready when you choose to look.

Oura Ring 4 is designed for daily wear, with titanium inside and out and recessed sensors. Typical battery life is 5–8 days, depending on size, settings and use.
